policy._doc: What a release must have verified (docs/plan-release-validation.md; scripts/release-changes.ts). Each cause of change is drawn on its own, big changes likelier, until its guarantee holds: the error rate's upper bound below `tolerance` at `confidence`, with at most `allowed` errors found. Visible changes (names, addresses, places new or gone) allow none; the sun and footprints three — each error makes the draw grow until the bound holds again (46 cases with one error, 61 with two, 76 with three; the owner's decision, 2026-10-26, after the three sun causes blocked on two errors each in 46 cases: 4 % wrong, bound 13 %), and a fourth blocks. Tolerance 10 % (the owner's decision, 2026-10-22, after a first round of 60 cases: 29 cases per big cause, 46 for the sun and footprints). A wrong change the team corrected (its name, address, terrace or status set by the team) no longer blocks: it was OSM's error, fixed for that place; only uncorrected errors do. Version 3 (2026-11-06, the owner's go): the bound is the finite population's — a cause of 46 changes needs 20 cases with no error, one of 665 needs 28 —; on a month's refresh of OSM alone (the cause's code production's), visible changes are weighed by place and risk, changesets are units, and a cause starts with half of what production's last release verified for it (releases/latest.json); trusted automatic checks take their passes out of the draw but for an audit; the quarantine's changes are drawn ahead (`upcoming`).

units._doc: Version 3 (2026-11-06): on a month's refresh, a changeset behind `min` changes of a cause or more is one unit of the draw; its first `sample` changes are verified, all right accept it, one wrong sends every change of it to the team.

risk._doc: Version 3: on a month's refresh, a visible change's weight in the draw is doubled in Paris (`paris`), where the app is read, and doubled again (`factor`) when its edit is riskier: a place deleted without a closure tag, a mapper with fewer than `newMapperChangesets` changesets, a rename alone in its changeset (`smallChangeset` changes or fewer).

checks._doc: Version 3: the automatic checks (scripts/lib/release-checks.ts). A change a trusted check passes leaves its cause's draw for an audit of one in `audit`; a check is trusted (`auto`) once its passes the team verified bound its error rate under the visible tolerance at the policy's confidence — its ledger, carried by production's releases/latest.json from one release to the next, starts from `seed`. `calibration`: measured, never trusted; `off`: not run.
